title: Plain-language NEAR glossary for new users (10 terms)
description: Write a short glossary for people new to NEAR who will use a dApp's wallet login. Define these 10 terms in plain language (one or two sentences each, no jargon in the definitions): account, named account, sub-account, access key, function-call key, gas, storage staking, yoctoNEAR, testnet, transaction hash. This is a low-stakes, non-urgent job: the poster cares most about price.

criteria.description: Every definition is factually correct for NEAR (accounts, sub-accounts, access keys, function-call keys, gas, storage staking, yoctoNEAR, testnet, transaction hash).
Definitions are short, plain-language and understandable by a non-technical user; no unexplained jargon.
